Hridoye Muktijuddho on Channel i
2013-12-05T00:00:00+06:00 | .
https://www.thedailystar.net/hridoye-muktijuddho-on-channel-i-1355

On the occasion of the month of victory, Channel i is airing a special programme on the Liberation War titled “Hridoye Muktijuddho”, featuring a discussion, documentary show, poetry recitation and musical soiree. The programme, aired at 5.30 pm everyday, will continue till December 16. Day to day events and major combats during the war are also brought to light on the show. The programme is directed and planned by Raju Alim. Actress Rokeya Prachi is the anchor of the programme.
